task_description: Build a browser-based low-poly 3D model editor with Three.js. Includes 3D viewport, primitive creation, edit modes (object/vertex/edge/face), manipulation tools, face color painting, flat/smooth shading toggle, undo/redo, and export to glTF/OBJ. Russian language UI.

verification.summary: npm run build completes successfully (31 modules transformed, output to dist/). npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors. No unit test framework for this UI-focused MVP - verification is via successful build and type checking.
